notes.title: Update of the demo version
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback during the "Steam Next Fest" festival. This allowed us to make a number of changes to the gameplay that will be included in the main game, and in the meantime, you can try them out in the demo version of the game.

Demo Version Update:

- Added time acceleration to shorten the waiting time when a level is already completed.
- Added a dark theme since there were players whose eyes became very tired due to the abundance of white color.

Information on the development of the main game:

We are actively working on implementing and testing new mechanics to diversify the gameplay and keep players engaged by continuously introducing new puzzles. 
With the introduction of new mechanics, the number of potential levels in the game is also increasing.

***We hope you will continue to leave feedback and share your thoughts about the game. This will help us make it better.

Leave your feedback and ask questions as reviews on the demo version of the game. 

Or write to us at: growfallsupp@gmail.com

We are happy to answer all your questions.
